resources.string: Trigger at any time of day
Separate window for Friday and Saturday nights.
If your alarm rings before the window ends, the mode already switches off at the alarm.
Only the selected charger types trigger the mode — e.g. wireless on the nightstand yes, USB at the PC no.
At least one charger type must stay selected.
Skipped tonight — mode will not activate.
Do Not Disturb access is missing — grant it below.
Charging, but outside the night window.
Charging in the night window — activating…
While this is on, ZenDock watches for the charger during the night window: plug in → bedtime mode on, unplug → off.
The charger only triggers the mode inside this window — plugging in during the day won\'t turn your screen gray. At the window\'s end the mode switches off even if the phone keeps charging.
Ignore the window and react to the charger around the clock.
Removes all color from the screen. Scrolling loses its pull — the strongest nudge to put the phone down.
Keeps the always-on display completely dark, so nothing glows on the nightstand.
Darkens the wallpaper while the mode is active.
Forces the dark theme. Android applies it the next time the screen turns off.
What may still disturb you: “Priority only” lets alarms, media and starred contacts through; “Alarms only” just alarms; “Total silence” nothing at all.

ZenDock registers its own mode in the system settings (Modes / Do Not Disturb) — you can fine-tune or toggle it manually there too.\n\nBattery: everything is event-driven. A small watcher runs only during the night window and just waits for charger events; there is no polling, plus two alarms per day for the window boundaries. The app has no internet access at all.
Bedtime mode active — unplug to end it.
